releaseNotes:
NextGenSoftware.OASIS.API.DNA v2.0.5

Defines the OASISDNA class and all associated configuration objects that control every aspect of OASIS runtime behaviour: active provider list, Auto-FailOver and Auto-LoadBalancing rules, Auto-Replication and Auto-Sync settings, encryption levels, FAHRN routing, HolonicBraid mesh config, API keys, and more. OASIS_DNA.json is loaded at startup and can be hot-swapped at runtime. Part of the OASIS Omniverse at https://oasisomniverse.one

What's new since v2.0.4
- Add checked encrypted record history to V2 EVM providers (aa48e66)
- Add explicit public S3 metadata CQL source and recover Oracle query adapter (64c0d94)
- Add server-authoritative OLAND checkout and recover historical Karma audits (613c56e)
- Bind Ethereum history through existing DNA registration (aa5173d)
- Complete OLAND NFT standard and public ownership metadata contracts (ca2b0d1)
- Enforce explicit Cosmos signed fee ceilings and wire DNA configuration (7fa8956)
- feat(aws): add encrypted S3 provider over shared SDK transport (c666a82)
- feat(aws): add session credentials and explicit SDK credential-chain mode (2d6fd02)
- feat(cosmos): wire reviewed escrow settings and verify stored-wallet release (a82c668)
- feat(cql): shared and inherited reads on for all general CQL providers (ff4a7ef)
- feat(hedera): configure explicit escrow protocol through OASISDNA (f867b5f)
- feat(hedera): wire explicit prepared query policy from OASISDNA (de8fff4)
- feat(HoloOASIS): STAR hApp generation fills STAR's Holochain07 templates (HolochainHappTemplateEngine); HoloOASIS.HolochainVersion + RustDNAHolochain07TemplateFolder settings; tests (STAR template output compiled with cargo and run on real 0.7.0 + 0.7.1 conductors by HoloNET's live tests) (4fda913)
- feat(solid): preserve encrypted history and conditional lifecycle integrity (2578d22)
- feat(sui): wire explicit deposit registry through OASISDNA (ebfc83f)
- feat(tron): configure id-bound custody and verify encrypted wallet release (c6aa3b7)
- Fix Rootstock V2 query authority and configured chain factory ownership (a69578d)
- fix(boot): select V2 Arbitrum and wire explicit EVM escrow settings (6fdb3d8)
- fix(boot): wire AWS and Azure SDK providers from explicit DNA settings (966a2dd)
- Implement conditional Azure Blob record history across public storage APIs (da6640e)
- Implement conditional DynamoDB and AWS record history with native verification (dfabb90)
- Integrate encrypted OCI OASIS provider with isolated namespaces and configuration (6689b80)
- Integrate Oracle shared record history with native race and corruption proof (2e024de)
- Integrate verified IPFS publication across provider instances (4221d2d)
- Integrate verified native BNB BootLoader registration (c6bcd75)
- Integrate verified Polkadot activation and zkPass attestation verification (3799646)
- Isolate the verified SQL Server BootLoader binding for Development (35940c2)
- Native data import API, Mongo native database setting, and sandbox demo shop data (2bc6b78)
- Native import: allow-private-addresses is a DNA setting (OASIS.NativeImport.AllowPrivateAddresses); pin Core and STAR ODK (05eba7d)
- Native import: Azure Cosmos, SOLID, ActivityPub, IPFS and Solana readers; STAR CLI nativeimport and cql commands; docs (fc85a95)
- Native import: SQLite and Neo4j readers, saved mappings API, sandbox demo data for all three stores (83daa69)
- Prepare explicit SOLID membership and cancellable read-only source activation (9add191)
- Prepare retained native IPFS demo source and explicit read-only query activation (131fd48)
- Preserve Firestore history with native conditional record writes (771c313)
- Qualify LocalFile storage directory on Development (e0ac96f)
- Sandbox and native import: every setting comes from DNA (OASIS.Sandbox, OASIS.NativeImport); no hard-coded limits or environment variables; pin Core and STAR ODK (203c4f9)
- Saved native-import connections: encrypted per avatar (DNA key), connectionName on native-data requests, connections endpoints, docs, tests; pin Core 0240771 (c8f4adc)
- Ship scoped hosted CQL source discovery and ActivityPub query examples (0f4ee31)
- Sync default OASIS DNA template with the DNA schema (f940a3f)
- Wire Cosmos record history option through OASISDNA registration (8602679)
- Wire explicit Sui gas budget ceilings through DNA and BootLoader (b0bb60e)
- Wire Oracle DNA configuration into provider registration (92b190f)
- Wire trusted Ethereum depositor escrow through SDK and OASISDNA (ab02175)
